baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic contemporary Japanese summer fashion photograph beside a sunlit beach, featuring two unmistakably adult Japanese people in their mid-twenties dressed in coordinated adult swimwear. A confident, deeply tanned man with bleached golden-blond hair, a patterned open resort shirt over black swim trunks, a gold chain, and a teasing grin performs a clear kabedon: his right palm planted flat on the beach-club wall beside the woman's head as he leans close. The adult woman is a reserved literature graduate student in a navy one-piece swimsuit with a light linen cover-up, holding an open paperback against her chest. She meets the same man's gaze with a level, cool expression, then quietly straightens his wind-lifted collar with her free hand. Her cool composure cracks into a warm blush across her ears; her thumb loses its page and several pages flutter, an already-visible consequence of his sudden closeness. Keep both faces, his braced arm, her target-directed gesture, the paperback, and their charged but playful relationship legible in one frame.
